# Magna Park Self Storage

> Foam insulated 20ft shipping container storage in Bournemouth, Dorset, UK.

## About
Magna Park Self Storage offers secure, foam-insulated 20ft shipping container storage in Bournemouth (BH11 9FA). Unlike standard shipping containers, all units are fully foam-lined to prevent condensation and protect belongings from temperature extremes. Pricing starts at £55/week with no VAT.

## Key Facts
- Location: 106 Provence Dr, Bournemouth, BH11 9FA, UK
- Phone: 01202 113255
- Email: info@magnaparkselfstore.co.uk
- Website: https://magnaparkselfstore.co.uk
- Price: £55/week, no VAT, no hidden fees
- Container size: 20ft (6.1m x 2.4m x 2.6m) — 1,360 cubic feet
- Capacity: Each container fits the contents of a 3-bedroom house
- Access: 24/7 with personal pin code
- Security: CCTV monitoring, perimeter fencing, secure gated entry
- Features: Foam insulated, drive-up access, flexible terms, no long contracts

## Storage Types
- Household furniture and personal items
- Business stock and inventory
- Vehicles (cars, motorbikes, trailers)
- Tools and trade equipment
- Documents and archives
- Student storage (Bournemouth University, Arts University Bournemouth)
- Classic car storage
- E-commerce/online seller storage

## Areas Served
Bournemouth, Poole, Christchurch, Wimborne, Ferndown, Dorset

## Pricing Comparison
Magna Park charges £55/week (£238/month) with no VAT. Major chains like Big Yellow and Safestore typically charge £120-£200/month plus 20% VAT for comparable space.
